u0: Initial RM state: the agent has not yet toggled the wall switch and is not on the exit. The next RM objective is to reach the exit; before exiting, it may optionally toggle the switch while not at the exit to earn the 0.2 bonus and enter u1. Box possession or loss and siren status are not encoded in this state.
u1: Post-switch RM state: the agent has toggled the wall switch at least once and has not yet reached the exit. The switch bonus has been collected; the remaining objective is to go to the exit and enter terminal state u2. Further toggles do not change this state. Box possession or loss and siren status are not encoded here.
u2: Terminal RM state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode has ended. There is no further objective or state transition; this is the successful final state.
